userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 EntitlementHub 的初级订阅运营工程师。每轮只推进一个产品目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、访问数据流和验证证据；绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、实现结构、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers the published V1 contract, UI, races, recovery, and tests.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件；给我分阶段计划、风险和验证方法。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain authority and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan, subscription, provider, entitlement, worker, event, and UI boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、Plan、Subscription、Provider callback、Entitlement、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 的职责。

scenes.title: Access flows
scenes.objective: Explain trial-to-access and refund-to-revocation flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Atomic and forbidden partial states are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释成功试用到权益生效，以及全额退款到实时撤权的完整状态和数据流。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author exact HTTP, state, error, seed, snapshot, work, and event contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: All boundaries are machine-checkable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Seed、Snapshot、Work、Event 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Verification
scenes.objective: Define meaningful real test layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each test layer proves different entitlement invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 各自验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build runnable production process boundaries.
scenes.advanceGate: API, worker, dispatcher, and UI build, boot, and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小 TypeScript、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并做真实 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement repeatable migration and strict atomic seed.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and rejection are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证重跑、完全 replay、版本冲突、未知成员和坏引用。

scenes.title: Plans
scenes.objective: Implement immutable PlanRevision terms.
scenes.advanceGate: Published price, periods, features, trial, grace, and refund terms freeze.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Plan 与不可变 PlanRevision，并验证后续版本不能改写历史周期。

scenes.title: Trials
scenes.objective: Implement globally unique trial consumption.
scenes.advanceGate: Concurrent starts create one trial identity and grants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 trial、one-trial-per-subject-plan-family 和并发试用竞争。

scenes.title: Activation and renewal
scenes.objective: Implement provider activation and frozen periods.
scenes.advanceGate: Duplicate and reordered callbacks converge on one period.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Subscription activation、renewal、Provider 重复乱序事件和冻结周期。

scenes.title: Plan changes
scenes.objective: Implement immediate upgrade and scheduled downgrade.
scenes.advanceGate: Proration and grant intervals reconcile without gap or overlap.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成立即升级、确定性 proration、期末降级和并发 change/cancel/renew。

scenes.title: Refund uncertainty
scenes.objective: Implement refund reservation, unknown outcome, and reconciliation.
scenes.advanceGate: Refunds never exceed charge and full refund revokes once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成部分/全额退款、UNKNOWN、主动 reconcile、重复乱序 callback 和并发额度守恒。

scenes.title: Expiry and cancellation
scenes.objective: Implement database-time terminal transitions.
scenes.advanceGate: Due work is exactly once and terminal states remain immutable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 cancellation、past due/grace、expiry 和数据库时间驱动的 Work。

scenes.title: Revocation fence
scenes.objective: Implement monotonic cross-process access revocation.
scenes.advanceGate: All APIs disable within two seconds and stale messages never re-enable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 EntitlementView、revocationVersion、stale cache bypass 和重复乱序传播。

scenes.title: Idempotency and events
scenes.objective: Prove unknown outcomes, replay, transactional audit, and outbox.
scenes.advanceGate: One logical transition has one business effect and stable event identity.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证未知 HTTP 结果、20 路 replay、两 API、重启，以及事务性 Audit/Event 和未知 ACK。

scenes.title: V1 UI and review
scenes.objective: Complete production UI and findings-first V1 review.
scenes.advanceGate: Real browser and all non-performance V1 gates pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实 Plan、Trial、Subscription、Change、Refund、Entitlement 和 Audit UI，并做 V1 全量 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Publish EntitlementPool and request impact analysis only.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact covers schema, API, worker, UI, compatibility, races, and tests.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】增加组织席位 EntitlementPool。Subscription 创建请求兼容新增可选 subscriptionKind: INDIVIDUAL | ORGANIZATION；V1 历史和省略字段按 INDIVIDUAL 解释。只有 ORGANIZATION 订阅可创建 Pool；Pool 冻结 subscriptionId、feature、初始 seatLimit 和当前 period，初始 seatLimit 不得超过 PlanRevision feature limit，个人订阅不自动迁移。Pool 状态为 ACTIVE | OVER_LIMIT | REVOKED | EXPIRED。公开形状为 EntitlementPool = {poolId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,subscriptionId:uuid,feature:string,seatLimit:int,state:string,version:int,periodStart:timestamp,periodEnd:timestamp,createdAt:timestamp} 与 SeatAssignment = {poolId:uuid,subjectId:string,state:ACTIVE|REVOKED|EXPIRED,assignedAt:timestamp,terminalAt:timestamp|null}；FINAL snapshot 使用 entitlementPools 与 seatAssignments。POST /api/v1/entitlement-pools 使用 {tenantId:uuid,subscriptionId:uuid,feature:string,seatLimit:int} 并返回 EntitlementPool；POST /api/v1/entitlement-pools/:poolId/assignments 使用 {subjectId:string,expectedPoolVersion:int}，POST /api/v1/entitlement-pools/:poolId/assignments/:subjectId/revoke 使用 {expectedPoolVersion:int}，两者返回 {pool:EntitlementPool,assignment:SeatAssignment}；GET /api/v1/entitlement-pools/:poolId/assignments 返回 {items:[SeatAssignment],nextCursor:string|null}。Pool version 从 0 开始，每次成功分配或撤销加 1，三个 mutation 都要求 durable Idempotency-Key。同一 Pool subject 唯一且 ACTIVE 不超过 seatLimit。upgrade/downgrade 按新 feature limit 调整 seatLimit；退款、取消、过期撤销 Pool；超限进入 OVER_LIMIT，不新增、不任意驱逐，显式撤销至合法后恢复 ACTIVE。稳定错误为 409 ORGANIZATION_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED、409 POOL_VERSION_CHANGED、409 POOL_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED、409 POOL_OVER_LIMIT、409 POOL_TERMINAL、409 SEAT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED、409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT 和 404 NOT_FOUND，并使用 V1 JSON error envelope。两 API 最后席位与 Subscription revoke/expire 竞争须串行化；Pool 调整与撤权分别使用公开 Work kind POOL_RECONCILE 和 POOL_REVOKE，aggregateId = poolId。撤权两秒内可见且旧传播不能重启用。迁移保留全部 V1 数据、Work、Event 和 replay。更新 OpenAPI、Worker、production UI 和所有测试。本轮只做影响分析和计划。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 EntitlementPool 对 schema、API、Worker、UI、兼容迁移、并发和测试的影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible Pool migration.
scenes.advanceGate: All V1 identities, grants, fences, work, events, and replay survive.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，并验证 V1 snapshot、pending Work、Event 和保存 replay 不变。

scenes.title: Pool lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement Pool and assignment API.
scenes.advanceGate: Capacity, uniqueness, expected version, and exact decisions pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Pool、SeatAssignment、expectedPoolVersion、容量和 OpenAPI。

scenes.title: Pool plan changes
scenes.objective: Implement over-limit and subscription-driven changes.
scenes.advanceGate: Upgrade/downgrade/refund/cancel/expiry yield one legal pool state.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Pool 与 upgrade、downgrade、退款、取消、过期的联动和 OVER_LIMIT。

scenes.title: Pool races and recovery
scenes.objective: Verify last-seat and revocation concurrency with controlled kills.
scenes.advanceGate: No oversubscription or stale access survives.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证两 API 最后席位竞争、assignment/revoke 竞争、Worker SIGKILL 和 outbox 未知 ACK。

scenes.title: Manager UI and regression
scenes.objective: Complete Pool UI and full real non-performance regression.
scenes.advanceGate: Production Chromium and all gates pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Pool UI，并运行真实 Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 回归。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run all fixed sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and all post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实指标并重算 trial、period、refund、grant、fence、event 和 Work。

scenes.title: Final handoff
scenes.objective: Complete final findings-first review and truthful handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Evidence, risks, and unrun checks are accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有证据的问题并给出准确 handoff。
